Author:     Magnus Melin <mkmelin+mozilla@iki.fi>

    Bug 2045553 - Fix perma intermittent comm/calendar/test/browser/views/browser_weekView.js |  testWeekViewCurrentDayHighlight - the displayed date should be highlighted as the current day - true == false. r=darktrojan
    
    Call the correct function to get day of week.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D305066

diff --git a/calendar/test/browser/views/browser_weekView.js b/calendar/test/browser/views/browser_weekView.js
index c17739160e6..416ac2c69ca 100644
--- a/calendar/test/browser/views/browser_weekView.js
+++ b/calendar/test/browser/views/browser_weekView.js
@@ -190,7 +190,7 @@ add_task(async function testWeekViewCurrentDayHighlight() {
     const container = CalendarTestUtils.weekView.getColumnContainer(window, i);
     Assert.equal(
       container.classList.contains("day-column-today"),
-      [4, 5, 6, 7, 1, 2, 3][today.getUTCDate()] == i,
+      [4, 5, 6, 7, 1, 2, 3][today.getUTCDay()] == i,
       "the displayed date should be highlighted as the current day"
     );
   }
